title: Kadane with Endpoints
statement:
Use Kadane’s algorithm to find the maximum-sum nonempty subarray. On ties choose the shortest, then the earliest starting index.

Input
Read n followed by n signed integers.

Output
Print the sum and its 1-based inclusive endpoints L R.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Every element has absolute value at most 10⁹.
